title: Zion Canyon Trail Ride at Jacobs Ranch
specs: Explore terrain that few visitors ever get to see.
Experience the land the way pioneers, ranchers, and cowboys did, from horseback.
gap: Price per ride not stated on the site.
blurb: Guests spend time getting to know their horse and learning riding fundamentals before the ride. Rides vary from relaxed scenic trips to faster-paced trotting, cantering, or galloping. The experience offers a chance to explore terrain few visitors see and feel the freedom of the West.
extraNote: Please call for hourly rates. · We do not book online or by email. Call now for more information or to book your trail ride.
